hints.title: Two Distinct Query Types
hints.text: The gather query requires k contiguous seats in a single row. The scatter query distributes k seats across available rows.

hints.title: Tracking Row Capacity Metrics
hints.text: Maintain the maximum available seats in any single row and the sum of available seats across rows up to maxRow.

hints.title: Range Segment Aggregation
hints.text: A segment tree over row indices tracks range maximum (for gather) and range sum (for scatter).

hints.title: Concert Hall Row Management Implementation

complexity.time: O(log n) for gather, amortized O(log n) for scatter
complexity.notes: Segment tree over n rows updates in O(log n); fully booked rows are skipped monotonically.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning rows linearly up to 50,000 for each query times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Segment tree arrays sized 4 * n maintain max and sum metrics.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses dual-purpose segment tree tracking both max capacity and total range sum.
